name: ai-word-math-bridge
description: Convert AI math responses into Word-ingestable MathML HTML and native OMML DOCX output.

scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && npm --prefix src/conversion test && node tests/source-extractors-smoke.mjs
scripts.word-delivery: npm --prefix src/word-delivery run convert -- --input sample-input.txt --out output
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run fixture && npm run convert-fixtures && npm run word-delivery
